name: Odina Asomaning-Raghavan
location: The Stockyard, Iron Bend, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Odina Asomaning-Raghavan is tall and broad-shouldered, built like someone who grew fast and hasn't finished, with very dark brown skin, a shaved head, and a jagged scar bisecting his right eyebrow from a fall three years ago. He has geneware color-cycling pupils — shifts between grey and gold in a slow pulse — which he got on credit from a Stockyard bodmod stall and hasn't finished paying off. His jaw is always slightly set, and he has the particular stillness of someone who learned early that looking ready prevents more problems than looking friendly. He walks with an economy of motion that is entirely self-taught.

Odina Asomaning-Raghavan aged out of the Brightmoor Reclamation Orphanage at sixteen and has been in Iron Bend since. He is technically a prospect for the Stockyard Irons, a mid-level territorial gang, which means he runs perimeter watches, collects small-vendor protection fees, and waits to be tested in ways he's trying not to think about. He is not by nature violent — which is the central tension of his life. He's good at watching and remembering and intimidating by presence alone, and he has told himself that is enough to build on. He has a small personal ELF shrine tattooed on his inner wrist — not digital, just ink — in the shape of a data-stream sigil.

core_fears: being forced to hurt someone and crossing a line he can't come back from
the shapeless future beyond the Irons — he has no other plan
core_desires: to matter to a group that won't abandon him when he's no longer useful
to find out what he's actually good for
coping_mechanisms: physical stillness and controlled breathing under pressure
reading — anything with a long narrative arc
blind_spots: loyalty to the Irons is partially manufactured self-deception; he mistakes belonging for safety
believes his non-violence will be respected indefinitely because it has been so far
psychology.secret: During a perimeter watch six weeks ago, he let a known Irons informant pass without reporting it — not for money, but because the man was with a child and Nnamdi couldn't do it. The Irons don't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: minimal, precise, Stockyard vernacular with occasional surprising formal turns from his reading
speech_patterns.cadence: slow and deliberate; never fills silence; lets pauses do work
verbal_tics: 'that's a thing' for anything he's processing but not ready to evaluate
never uses contractions when he's being serious
example_lines: 'That is a thing I am going to need to think about before I answer.'
'Twice means you watch it happen, then you watch it happen again before you decide what it means. Most people stop at once.'

story_hooks: The informant he let pass is about to be identified by the Irons through another route — which will reveal Nnamdi's omission and put him in genuine danger.
A Brightmoor Reclamation social worker who knew him at the orphanage has found him in Iron Bend and is trying to offer him an Arcturus labor apprenticeship that has a two-week enrollment window.
narrative_function: Moral ambiguity anchor; neither antagonist nor ally by default; represents the pipeline from orphanage to gang. Potential person to be pulled a different direction or to provide reluctant gang intelligence.
augmentations: Color-cycling pupils (geneware, grey/gold, on-credit). No other augmentations.
daily_life: Irregular hours dictated by Irons schedules; perimeter watch shifts, fee collection rounds through vendor rows, long stretches of waiting in Iron Bend stairwells that he spends reading salvaged print media.
affiliation: Stockyard Irons (prospect, not full member); formerly Brightmoor Reclamation Orphanage

decision_rules: do not escalate if presence alone will hold the line
protect anyone smaller without making it a point of principle
escalation_ladder: physically remove himself from the situation if crossing a line is the only remaining option

interpersonal_modes.strangers: still, neutral, assessing; will not speak first; not threatening unless threatened
interpersonal_modes.friends: rare but total investment; remembers everything told to him; shows care through action not language

stress_responses.low: goes very quiet, reads if he can
stress_responses.medium: overrides emotion with physical routine — walks perimeter patterns compulsively
stress_responses.high: complete emotional shutdown; becomes operationally functional and privately fractured

contradictions: has a deep ethical code that is incompatible with his current affiliation, and does not fully admit this to himself
habits: traces the wrist-tattoo sigil when uncertain
files salvaged print pages in order even though he doesn't have a full collection of anything
breaking_points: being ordered to hurt a child or someone clearly helpless
discovering the Irons have been using him in a way that contradicts his stated value to them

physical_description.heritage: Mixed Sub-Saharan African (25.8%), Indigenous American (20.1%), South Asian (19.8%), Hispanic/Latin American (17.9%), and Southeast Asian (16.4%) ancestry. This complex blend produces warm deep brown skin with subtle golden and reddish undertones, broad facial structure with high cheekbones characteristic of both Indigenous American and South Asian heritage, and the rich warmth of African and Latin American ancestry blended across the complexion. Features are neither sharply angular nor soft — a balanced synthesis of multiple continental ancestries.
physical_description.build: Tall and broad-shouldered with the angular musculature of rapid adolescent growth not yet fully settled into adult mass. Long-limbed, still carrying some of the ungainliness of a teenager who outgrew himself.
physical_description.eye_color: Color-cycling geneware pupils — cycle between grey and gold in slow, deliberate pulses. Sclera remains natural brown-black.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and subtle reddish undertones, uniform complexion across face and body with the characteristic richness that comes from African, Indigenous American, South Asian, and Southeast Asian heritage blending
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, jawline broad and prominent with high cheekbones characteristic of Indigenous American and South Asian genetics. Skin condition unremarkable — no visible acne or dermatological marks beyond the scar. Facial expression habitually neutral, jaw set with the stillness of someone who learned to read rooms before learning to smile in them.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged scar bisecting the right eyebrow, running approximately 4cm from temple to bridge of nose, with visible white scarring — three years old, healed but still prominent
Small ELF shrine tattoo on inner right wrist in the shape of a vertical data-stream sigil, rendered in black ink, approximately 3cm tall
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-cycling geneware pupils are the only visible augmentation — the effect is subtle but unmistakable under direct light, a slow grey-to-gold pulse synchronized to his heartbeat. No chrome, no subdermal protrusions, no external hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economy of motion that is entirely self-taught. Walks with minimal wasted energy, shoulders held level, never fidgeting. Stillness is his default state — he sits motionless in stairwells for hours. When he moves, it is deliberate and unhurried, the body language of someone who learned that sudden movement draws attention and attention draws problems.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 working class / gang prospect. Typically wears a graphite-grey hoodie (no corporate branding, generic manufacture), dark cargo pants with worn knees, and scuffed black synthetic-leather boots with reinforced toe caps. Underneath, a faded white t-shirt. No visible gang insignia beyond informal markers — a brass knuckle ring on his left hand, a frayed paracord wristband in black on his right wrist. Clothing is functional and cheap, maintained rather than stylish, with small tears and stains that suggest hard use and indifference to appearance.
